entries.title: Demo One
entries.summary: The first PAL PlayStation demo disc brings playable games, previews and interactive technology demonstrations together.
body: Demo One accompanies the original PAL PlayStation launch model, SCPH-1002, on 29 September 1995. The disc introduces the console through a collection rather than a single game. Its first edition is distinct from later discs that share the Demo One name.

Four playable demonstrations form the games selection: Wipeout, Loaded, Destruction Derby and Battle Arena Toshinden. Different genres sit together on one disc, giving a new console owner several ways to try its controls and real-time graphics.

The preview selection includes Tekken, Warhawk, Twisted Metal, Rapid Reload, Ridge Racer, Jumping Flash! and Starblade Alpha. Total NBA 96 also appears as a rolling demonstration with a controllable camera. These presentations have a different role from the playable game samples.

Dinosaur and Manta Ray offer interactive technology demonstrations alongside the V-CD extra. The menu itself has four main icons and music credited to Harry Holmwood. Together, the interface and demonstrations make the disc a compact introduction to the early PlayStation.
